Players Committee card image of [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
